Q1352.description: Chennai is a city in Tamil Nadu. Its point represents the city; it does not identify a heritage monument or an exact filming address.

heritage:249.description: A UNESCO World Heritage property at Mamallapuram, with Pallava-period temples, rock-cut monuments and reliefs. This is a named heritage property, separate from the city of Chennai.

Q1438739.name: Fort St. George
Q1438739.description: A named historic fort in Chennai, described by the Chennai District administration and maintained by the Archaeological Survey of India. Its inclusion is a heritage reference, not evidence that a film was shot there.
